scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run setup:user
scripts.setup:local: npm run db:local && npm run bootstrap:local -w backend && npm run setup
scripts.format: prettier --write backend/src backend/tests database/seeds frontend/src package.json backend/package.json frontend/package.json
